data.spec: IMPLEMENTED locally (outside current PR stack): POST /api/input optional event_id/conversation_id routes room availability and owner-message followups into one existing durable task; legacy /requests/:id/transcript and speech DeviceEvents work too. GET /api/room-conversations/:id returns current task/progress; /api/requests overlay supplies trace and room_workflow. Same task.updated/requests.updated/board.say + room.progress stream operational steps. Private read-only room calendar/contact JSON adapter: current test calendar explicitly simulated, no real booking writes. Cheap personal WhatsApp worker apps/whatsapp is paired via user phone, running, no incoming-chat ingestion. Token-auth heartbeat/one-shot queueclaim/receipt routes as published; queued!=sent, only provider acknowledgements advance sent/delivered/read; lost claim becomes uncertain after30s, unclaimed expires120s, no automatic sends retry. Callback optional event:'claim'|'update' maps normal claim to sending progress. Live /api/input test with configured Anthropic generated a fresh message and paired worker received actual DELIVERY_ACK within3s. No native desktop automation used. Preserve source/private files, no session/phone inGit. Hardware caller should forward returnedconversation_id + stableevent_id for retry; station-scoped fallback10min supports existing caller. Keep worker running alongside dev runtime.
